name: spec-flow
description: Ships a feature only when a test that actually ran proves every requirement in its spec. Free-text requirement -> spec (you sign it off) -> plan -> review -> implement per milestone, gated by a lint/test/spec-trace loop that runs outside the model. For Node projects; your repo declares its test and lint commands in .spec-flow/config.json, which `spec-flow init` writes.

live_view.title: Live view
live_view.description: A pane and a status line showing each spec-flow agent while it works: its time, tool calls and tokens. It only shows, and gates nothing. Needs a Claude Code with function hooks; older versions skip it.
